dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Egypt is at risk due to behavioral reasons. In his previous home, Egypt has a history of redirection and biting when people attempt to interrupt him mounting the resident female dogs. These bites were bite and release that did break skin. His previous owner describes him as social and affectionate. While in care, Egypt has been observed to have a neutral body and wagging tail. While on walks, Egypt is aloof with handlers. Medically, Egypt has moderate to severe dental disease, lameness in their right front leg.

Egypt arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as social and affectionate. In his previous home, Egypt has a history of redirection and biting when people attempt to interrupt him mounting the resident female dogs. These bites were bite and release that did break skin. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
